history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration continue to closely and centrally monitor the regular budget redeployments of various entities, when warranted exceptionally.
history.administration_response: The Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance will continue to monitor regular budget redeployments in compliance with the existing budget policies and legislative framework. The Department continues to provide guidance and support to programme managers in departments who have delegated authority to perform these redeployments. Existing policies and the manual in place provide sufficient guidance on budget redeployment, with separate workflows for budget redeployments to be approved at: (a) the entity/office/mission level; and (b) the central level by the Administration. Therefore, the Administration requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that existing policies and the manual in place provide sufficient guidance on budget redeployment, and contain separate workflows for budget redeployment approval, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
